headline: Share India Securities Limited: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
sum: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company vide Resolution passed by circulation on November 04, 2026,…
detail: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company vide Resolution passed by circulation on November 04, 2026, approved the grant of 3,80,500 employee stock options to the Eligible Employees under the Share India Employees Stock Option Scheme -II pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited.

sources.name: NSE filing - Share India Securities Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
